title: Clovey Restaurant
summary: A warm, fast, mobile-first website for a modern restaurant — menu, story, and reservations in one effortless experience.
body:
Clovey needed a website that felt as considered as the food. We designed and built a brand-forward, mobile-first site that puts the menu, the story, and the booking flow within a tap of each other.

The build is fast by default — optimised images, clean semantic markup, and search-friendly structure so the restaurant ranks for the searches that matter locally. Reservations and contact are friction-free on a phone, where most diners actually decide.

The result is a site that loads quickly, reads beautifully, and turns a casual visit into a booking.
challenge: Clovey needed a website as considered as the food — and one that worked where diners actually decide: on a phone. The brand deserved better than a slow, generic template that was painful to update.
approach: We designed a brand-forward, mobile-first experience that puts the menu, the story, and the booking flow a tap apart. The build is fast by default — optimised images, clean semantic markup, and a search-friendly structure — and fully editable without a developer.
outcome: A site that loads quickly, reads beautifully, and turns a casual visit into a booking. Menus and hours update in seconds, and the structure is built to rank for the local searches that fill tables.
seoTitle: Clovey Restaurant — Restaurant Website Case Study
seoDescription: How we designed and built a fast, brand-forward, mobile-first website for Clovey Restaurant — menu, story, and bookings.

title: FitPlanCoach
summary: A production-grade fitness web app that turns coaching plans into a clean, guided experience for clients.
body:
FitPlanCoach is a web application built to make coaching scalable. We designed and engineered a clear, guided product where plans, progress, and day-to-day actions live in one place.

Under the hood it's a modern, type-safe stack built to grow — fast page loads, a responsive interface that works on the gym floor, and an architecture ready for new features without a rewrite. The interface stays out of the way so the training does the talking.

From UI to backend, it was delivered end to end by one senior team.
challenge: FitPlanCoach needed to make coaching scalable — turning plans, progress, and daily actions into one clear product instead of spreadsheets and scattered messages.
approach: We designed and engineered a guided web app on a modern, type-safe stack: fast page loads, a responsive interface that works on the gym floor, and an architecture ready for new features without a rewrite.
outcome: A production-grade product that feels effortless for clients and was delivered end to end by one senior team — from UI to backend — and ready to grow.
seoTitle: FitPlanCoach — Fitness Web App Case Study
seoDescription: How we designed and built FitPlanCoach, a production-grade fitness web app, end to end on a modern stack.
